verses.ar: اِحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ لِأَنَّهُ صَالِحٌ، لِأَنَّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: because his mercy [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.he: הֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־טֹ֑וב כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِيَقُلْ إِسْرَائِيلُ: «إِنَّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتَهُ».
verses.kjv: Let Israel now say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.he: יֹֽאמַר־נָ֥א יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِيَقُلْ بَيْتُ هَارُونَ: «إِنَّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتَهُ».
verses.kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֥א בֵֽית־אַהֲרֹ֑ן כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: لِيَقُلْ مُتَّقُو ٱلرَّبِّ: «إِنَّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتَهُ».
verses.kjv: Let them now that fear the LORD say, that his mercy [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: Now let those who fear Yahweh say that his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.he: יֹֽאמְרוּ־נָ֭א יִרְאֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּֽו׃

verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلضِّيقِ دَعَوْتُ ٱلرَّبَّ فَأَجَابَنِي مِنَ ٱلرُّحْبِ.
verses.kjv: I called upon the LORD in distress: the LORD answered me, [and set me] in a large place.
verses.web: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.
verses.he: מִֽן־הַ֭מֵּצַ֥ר קָרָ֣אתִי יָּ֑הּ עָנָ֖נִי בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב יָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ لِي فَلَا أَخَافُ. مَاذَا يَصْنَعُ بِي ٱلْإِنْسَانُ؟
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?
verses.web: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י לֹ֣א אִירָ֑א מַה־יַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה לִ֣י אָדָֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ لِي بَيْنَ مُعِينِيَّ، وَأَنَا سَأَرَى بِأَعْدَائِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see [my desire] upon them that hate me.
verses.web: Yahweh is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.
verses.he: יְהוָ֣ה לִ֭י בְּעֹזְרָ֑י וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶרְאֶ֥ה בְשֹׂנְאָֽי׃

verses.ar: ٱلِٱحْتِمَاءُ بِٱلرَّبِّ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَى إِنْسَانٍ.
verses.kjv: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in man.
verses.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in man.
verses.he: טֹ֗וב לַחֲסֹ֥ות בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בָּאָדָֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلِٱحْتِمَاءُ بِٱلرَّبِّ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلتَّوَكُّلِ عَلَى ٱلرُّؤَسَاءِ.
verses.kjv: [It is] better to trust in the LORD than to put confidence in princes.
verses.web: It is better to take refuge in Yahweh, than to put confidence in princes.
verses.he: טֹ֗וב לַחֲסֹ֥ות בַּיהוָ֑ה מִ֝בְּטֹ֗חַ בִּנְדִיבִֽים׃

verses.ar: كُلُّ ٱلْأُمَمِ أَحَاطُوا بِي. بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ أُبِيدُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD will I destroy them.
verses.web: All the nations surrounded me, but in Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
verses.he: כָּל־גֹּויִ֥ם סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

verses.ar: أَحَاطُوا بِي وَٱكْتَنَفُونِي. بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ أُبِيدُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.web: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In Yahweh’s name I indeed cut them off.
verses.he: סַבּ֥וּנִי גַם־סְבָב֑וּנִי בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

verses.ar: أَحَاطُوا بِي مِثْلَ ٱلنَّحْلِ. ٱنْطَفَأُوا كَنَارِ ٱلشَّوْكِ. بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ أُبِيدُهُمْ.
verses.kjv: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the LORD I will destroy them.
verses.web: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In Yahweh’s name I cut them off.
verses.he: סַבּ֤וּנִי כִדְבֹורִ֗ים דֹּ֭עֲכוּ כְּאֵ֣שׁ קֹוצִ֑ים בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה כִּ֣י אֲמִילַֽם׃

verses.ar: دَحَرْتَنِي دُحُورًا لِأَسْقُطَ، أَمَّا ٱلرَّبُّ فَعَضَدَنِي.
verses.kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the LORD helped me.
verses.web: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but Yahweh helped me.
verses.he: דַּחֹ֣ה דְחִיתַ֣נִי לִנְפֹּ֑ל וַ֖יהוָ֣ה עֲזָרָֽנִי׃

verses.ar: قُوَّتِي وَتَرَنُّمِي ٱلرَّبُّ، وَقَدْ صَارَ لِي خَلَاصًا.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and is become my salvation.
verses.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.
verses.he: עָזִּ֣י וְזִמְרָ֣ת יָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

verses.ar: صَوْتُ تَرَنُّمٍ وَخَلَاصٍ فِي خِيَامِ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ: «يَمِينُ ٱلرَّبِّ صَانِعَةٌ بِبَأْسٍ.
verses.kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation [is] in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.web: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly.
verses.he: קֹ֤ול ׀ רִנָּ֬ה וִֽישׁוּעָ֗ה בְּאָהֳלֵ֥י צַדִּיקִ֑ים יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

verses.ar: يَمِينُ ٱلرَّبِّ مُرْتَفِعَةٌ. يَمِينُ ٱلرَّبِّ صَانِعَةٌ بِبَأْسٍ».
verses.kjv: The right hand of the LORD is exalted: the right hand of the LORD doeth valiantly.
verses.web: The right hand of Yahweh is exalted! The right hand of Yahweh does valiantly!”
verses.he: יְמִ֣ין יְ֭הוָה רֹומֵמָ֑ה יְמִ֥ין יְ֝הוָה עֹ֣שָׂה חָֽיִל׃

verses.ar: لَا أَمُوتُ بَلْ أَحْيَا وَأُحَدِّثُ بِأَعْمَالِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the LORD.
verses.web: I will not die, but live, and declare Yah’s works.
verses.he: לֹֽא אָמ֥וּת כִּי־אֶֽחְיֶ֑ה וַ֝אֲסַפֵּ֗ר מַֽעֲשֵׂ֥י יָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: تَأْدِيبًا أَدَّبَنِي ٱلرَّبُّ، وَإِلَى ٱلْمَوْتِ لَمْ يُسْلِمْنِي.
verses.kjv: The LORD hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.
verses.web: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.
verses.he: יַסֹּ֣ר יִסְּרַ֣נִּי יָּ֑הּ וְ֝לַמָּ֗וֶת לֹ֣א נְתָנָֽנִי׃

verses.ar: اِفْتَحُوا لِي أَبْوَابَ ٱلْبِرِّ. أَدْخُلْ فِيهَا وَأَحْمَدِ ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, [and] I will praise the LORD:
verses.web: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.
verses.he: פִּתְחוּ־לִ֥י שַׁעֲרֵי־צֶ֑דֶק אָֽבֹא־בָ֝ם אֹודֶ֥ה יָֽהּ׃

verses.ar: هَذَا ٱلْبَابُ لِلرَّبِّ. ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: This gate of the LORD, into which the righteous shall enter.
verses.web: This is the gate of Yahweh; the righteous will enter into it.
verses.he: זֶֽה־הַשַּׁ֥עַר לַיהוָ֑ה צַ֝דִּיקִ֗ים יָבֹ֥אוּ בֹֽו׃

verses.ar: أَحْمَدُكَ لِأَنَّكَ ٱسْتَجَبْتَ لِي وَصِرْتَ لِي خَلَاصًا.
verses.kjv: I will praise thee: for thou hast heard me, and art become my salvation.
verses.web: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.
verses.he: אֹ֭ודְךָ כִּ֣י עֲנִיתָ֑נִי וַתְּהִי־לִ֝֗י לִֽישׁוּעָֽה׃

verses.ar: ٱلْحَجَرُ ٱلَّذِي رَفَضَهُ ٱلْبَنَّاؤُونَ قَدْ صَارَ رَأْسَ ٱلزَّاوِيَةِ.
verses.kjv: The stone [which] the builders refused is become the head [stone] of the corner.
verses.web: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
verses.he: אֶ֭בֶן מָאֲס֣וּ הַבֹּונִ֑ים הָ֝יְתָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ פִּנָּֽה׃

verses.ar: مِنْ قِبَلِ ٱلرَّبِّ كَانَ هَذَا، وَهُوَ عَجِيبٌ فِي أَعْيُنِنَا.
verses.kjv: This is the LORD’s doing; it [is] marvellous in our eyes.
verses.web: This is Yahweh’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.
verses.he: מֵאֵ֣ת יְ֭הוָה הָ֣יְתָה זֹּ֑את הִ֖יא נִפְלָ֣את בְּעֵינֵֽינוּ׃

verses.ar: هَذَا هُوَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِي صَنَعُهُ ٱلرَّبُّ، نَبْتَهِجُ وَنَفْرَحُ فِيهِ.
verses.kjv: This [is] the day [which] the LORD hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
verses.web: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!
verses.he: זֶה־הַ֭יֹּום עָשָׂ֣ה יְהוָ֑ה נָגִ֖ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָ֣ה בֹֽו׃

verses.ar: آهِ يَارَبُّ خَلِّصْ! آهِ يَارَبُّ أَنْقِذْ!
verses.kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O LORD: O LORD, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.
verses.web: Save us now, we beg you, Yahweh! Yahweh, we beg you, send prosperity now.
verses.he: אָנָּ֣א יְ֭הוָה הֹושִׁ֘יעָ֥ה נָּ֑א אָֽנָּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה הַצְלִ֘יחָ֥ה נָּֽא׃

verses.ar: مُبَارَكٌ ٱلْآتِي بِٱسْمِ ٱلرَّبِّ. بَارَكْنَاكُمْ مِنْ بَيْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.kjv: Blessed [be] he that cometh in the name of the LORD: we have blessed you out of the house of the LORD.
verses.web: Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
verses.he: בָּר֣וּךְ הַ֭בָּא בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֝רַֽכְנוּכֶ֗ם מִבֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ هُوَ ٱللهُ وَقَدْ أَنَارَ لَنَا. أَوْثِقُوا ٱلذَّبِيحَةَ بِرُبُطٍ إِلَى قُرُونِ ٱلْمَذْبَحِ.
verses.kjv: God [is] the LORD, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, [even] unto the horns of the altar.
verses.web: Yahweh is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.
verses.he: אֵ֤ל ׀ יְהוָה֮ וַיָּ֪אֶר לָ֥נוּ אִסְרוּ־חַ֥ג בַּעֲבֹתִ֑ים עַד־קַ֝רְנֹ֗ות הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

verses.ar: إِلَهِي أَنْتَ فَأَحْمَدُكَ، إِلَهِي فَأَرْفَعُكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] my God, and I will praise thee: [thou art] my God, I will exalt thee.
verses.web: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.
verses.he: אֵלִ֣י אַתָּ֣ה וְאֹודֶ֑ךָּ אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אֲרֹומְמֶֽךָּ׃

verses.ar: ٱحْمَدُوا ٱلرَّبَّ لِأَنَّهُ صَالِحٌ، لِأَنَّ إِلَى ٱلْأَبَدِ رَحْمَتَهُ.
verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.
verses.web: Oh give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.
verses.he: הֹוד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־טֹ֑וב כִּ֖י לְעֹולָ֣ם חַסְדֹּֽו׃
